commits_data.title: smb2: allow decryption using keys learned by kerberos
commits_data.message:
smb2: allow decryption using keys learned by kerberos

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>

commits_data.title: smb2: support 32bit session keys they are used with kerberos
commits_data.message:
smb2: support 32bit session keys they are used with kerberos

Note only the derived 32 byte (256-bit) aes encryption keys use the
full 32bit session key, in other places it's truncated to
16 bytes.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>

commits_data.title: smb2: mark invalid frame_{req,res} with UINT32_MAX, frame_req=0 can be a valid one
commits_data.message:
smb2: mark invalid frame_{req,res} with UINT32_MAX, frame_req=0 can be a valid one

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>

commits_data.title: kerberos: copy pac_names from EncTicketPart_key to EncAPRepPart_subkey
commits_data.message:
kerberos: copy pac_names from EncTicketPart_key to EncAPRepPart_subkey

This means application layers like SMB2 can use it for keys having
is_ap_rep_key=true.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>

commits_data.title: kerberos: let dissect_krb5_PAC_DEVICE_INFO/netlogon_dissect_PAC_DEVICE_INFO provide device_sid
commits_data.message:
kerberos: let dissect_krb5_PAC_DEVICE_INFO/netlogon_dissect_PAC_DEVICE_INFO provide device_sid

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>

commits_data.title: kerberos: remember account details from dissect_krb5_PAC_UPN_DNS_INFO on EncTicketPart_key
commits_data.message:
kerberos: remember account details from dissect_krb5_PAC_UPN_DNS_INFO on EncTicketPart_key

This will be used in the following commits.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>

commits_data.title: kerberos: simplify struct dcerpc_info faking und use ptype = UINT8_MAX
commits_data.message:
kerberos: simplify struct dcerpc_info faking und use ptype = UINT8_MAX

This means all fields are initialized and we use ptype = UINT8_MAX
in order to indicate that it's not a real PDU_REQ.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>

commits_data.title: dcerpc-netlogon: let netlogon_dissect_PAC_DEVICE_INFO() generate a device_sid
commits_data.message:
dcerpc-netlogon: let netlogon_dissect_PAC_DEVICE_INFO() generate a device_sid

The caller (dissect_krb5_PAC_DEVICE_INFO) will pass in a const char
**device_sid_ptr in call_data->private_data soon.

And it will expect the device_sid to be allocated on
wmem_epan_scope().

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>

commits_data.title: dcerpc-nt: add dissect_ndr_nt_PSID_cb()
commits_data.message:
dcerpc-nt: add dissect_ndr_nt_PSID_cb()

This will allow a caller to make use of the sid string stored
in call_data->private_data...

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>

commits_data.title: dcerpc-nt: let dissect_ndr_nt_PSID use CB_STR_ITEM_LEVELS(2)
commits_data.message:
dcerpc-nt: let dissect_ndr_nt_PSID use CB_STR_ITEM_LEVELS(2)

So that the sid is also visible without opening the subtrees.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Metzmacher <metze@samba.org>
